controls.Triangle: Enter vehicle / secondary attack / pick up
controls.L1: Center camera / view stats / fire weapon

evidence.On foot/L1: pdf3 (printed 03): L1 button - CENTER THE CAMERA/VIEW STATS/FIRE WEAPON

evidence.On foot/Down: pdf3 (printed 03): Down arrow button - GANG PASSIVE MODE
evidence.On foot/Right: pdf3 (printed 03): Right arrow button - TALK POSITIVE RESPONSE
evidence.On foot/Left: pdf3 (printed 03): Left arrow button - TALK NEGATIVE RESPONSE
evidence.Bicycle/Cross: pdf3 (printed 03) Controls: Bicycle: X button HOLD - PEDAL; X button TAP - PEDAL FASTER (SPRINT)
evidence.Bicycle/L1: pdf3 (printed 03): L1 button - BUNNYHOP; L1 button HOLD - BUNNYHOP HIGHER
evidence.In vehicle/Triangle: pdf4 (printed 04) Controls: In Vehicle: Triangle button - EXIT VEHICLE

evidence.First person shooting/R2: pdf4 (printed 04): L2/R2 buttons - ZOOM IN/ZOOM OUT
evidence.First person shooting/R1: pdf4 (printed 04): R1 button - (LET GO TO RETURN TO NORMAL CONTROL)

evidence.Aircraft/Circle: pdf4 (printed 04) Plane: Circle button - ALTERNATE WEAPON
